app_localization.title: Antigravity App localization (experimental)
app_localization.subtitle: Optional static controls in the official App. Off by default; separate from Tools’ language.
app_localization.notice: Experimental: macOS and official Antigravity App 2.19.1 only. Open the App normally first. Tools connects only to its existing verified local endpoint; unknown versions or changed layouts are blocked.
app_localization.coverage: Current verified scope: the Settings entry button. The broader Settings navigation is awaiting live validation. Chat, code, terminals, paths, input values, account names, projects and native system menus are excluded.
app_localization.stop_notice: Disabling attempts to restore only this tool’s labels. If the connection is lost, automatic cleanup is best-effort; restart the App if restoration cannot be confirmed. The official App manages its own debugging interface.

states.restart_required: Disabled; restart the app normally to finish restoring

details.unverified_adapter: No verified interface adapter is available. The app was not launched or injected.

details.app_required: Install the official Antigravity App first.
